dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Here is my passport and arrival card.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: What is the purpose of your visit?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I am here for tourism.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: How long will you stay?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I will stay for one week.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: Where will you be staying?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: At the Grand Hotel in downtown.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: Enjoy your stay!

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I would like a luggage cart, please.
dialogues.ko: 수하물 카트 한 대 빌릴 수 있나요?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Here you go. The baggage carousel is over there.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, which carousel is for flight AA123?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: It is Carousel B, next to the exit.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, that suitcase is not mine.
dialogues.ko: 실례합니다, 그 여행 가방은 제 것이 아닙니다.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.en: I apologize. Can you describe the bag?
dialogues.ko: 죄송합니다. 가방을 설명해 주실 수 있나요?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: It is black, a hard-shell suitcase, large in size.
dialogues.ko: 검은색, 하드쉘 여행 가방, 큰 사이즈 입니다.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I have nothing to declare.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: Are you carrying foods or plants?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: No, just personal souvenirs.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: Please proceed to the exit.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Good evening, I have a reservation.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: May I have your name, please?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Kim. I booked for three nights.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Found it. Could I see your passport and credit card?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Here you go. Do you have a non-smoking room?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Yes, here is your key card. Room 809, the eighth floor.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: What time is breakfast served?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Breakfast is from 6:30 to 10:00 AM on the second floor.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Is the Wi-Fi free?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Yes, the password is on the information card on your desk.
dialogues.ko: 네, 비밀번호는 책상 위 안내 카드에 있습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Can I use the gym pool?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: The hotel does not have a pool, but the gym is on the top floor. Open from 6 AM to 10 PM.
dialogues.ko: 수영장은 없으나, 지상 체육관은 있습니다. 오전 6시부터 저녁 10시까지 입니다.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Hi, I'd like to check out, please.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Did you enjoy your stay?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Yes, it was wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Can I get a receipt for my credit card?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Sure, it will be ready in a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Thank you, and have a safe trip home!

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Good evening, are you expecting us?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: May I have your name?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: We have a reservation for two under Kim.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Right this way, please.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Can we sit near the window?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Of course. Here is your table by the window.

dialogues.speaker: Speaker
dialogues.en: Can I see the menu, please?

dialogues.speaker: Speaker
dialogues.en: What do you recommend?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: The grilled salmon is our special today.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I think I'll have that, please.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: And I would like a glass of water, please.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Would you like something to drink?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: A glass of red wine, please.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, can we get the bill?

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Here you go. Would you like to pay by cash or card?
dialogues.ko: 계산서 입니다. 현금 또는 카드 결제 중 원하시나요?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: By card, please.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Do you leave a tip?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: No, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Thank you for dining with us.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, are you available?

dialogues.speaker: Driver
dialogues.en: Where to, please?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Could you take me to Times Square, please?

dialogues.speaker: Driver
dialogues.en: Sure, it is about a 15-minute ride.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: How much will the fare roughly be?

dialogues.speaker: Driver
dialogues.en: It will be around $25, depending on traffic.
dialogues.ko: 교통 상황에 따라 약 25달러 나올 것 같습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, could you help me?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Sure, what do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: How do I get to the central museum?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left.
dialogues.ko: 두 블록 직진한 뒤 왼쪽으로 꺾으시면 됩니다.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Is it a short walk? About 10 minutes?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: It is about 15 minutes from here.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, I have lost my wallet.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: When did you last see it?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I think it was at the restaurant in the mall.
dialogues.ko: 쇼핑 몰 식당 에서 잃어버린 것 같습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: Let me check our lost and found. Can you describe it?
dialogues.ko: 분실물 센터를 확인해 볼게요. 모양을 설명해 주시겠나요?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: It is brown leather with some credit cards inside.
dialogues.ko: 갈색 가죽 지갑이고, 신용카드가 들어 있습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Staff
dialogues.en: We received a similar one. Here it is.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Excuse me, I was robbed.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: Are you hurt?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: No, I am fine. But they took my bag.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: Please describe what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I was walking near the station and someone snatched my bag.
dialogues.ko: 역 근처를 걷는데 누군가 내 가방을 찼습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Officer
dialogues.en: I will file a report. You can use my laptop to contact the embassy.
dialogues.ko: 신고서를 작성하겠습니다. 대사관 연락을 위해 노트북을 쓰셔도 됩니다.

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Can someone please help me? I am very sick.
dialogues.ko: 도와주실 분 계신가요? 아파서 매우 아픕니다.

dialogues.speaker: Stranger
dialogues.en: What is wrong? Do we need to call an ambulance?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: I think I have a bad headache and stomach pain.

dialogues.speaker: Stranger
dialogues.en: Let me call emergency services. Is there a nearby hospital?
dialogues.ko: 緊急 서비스를 호출할게요. 근처에 병원 있습니까?

dialogues.speaker: Guest
dialogues.en: Yes, there is one one block from here.
dialogues.ko: 네, 여기에서 한 블록 거리에 있습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Stranger
dialogues.en: The ambulance is coming. Please stay calm.
